# Read semver.py to check regex and overall structure
with open('semver.py', 'r') as f:
    lines = f.readlines()

print("=== Regex section (lines 10-40) ===")
for i in range(max(0, 10), min(40, len(lines))):
    print(f"{i+1}: {lines[i]}", end='')

print("\n=== Checking imports/exports ===")
# Check if cmd_bump, cmd_check, cmd_compare are accessible
import semver
print("cmd_bump:", hasattr(semver, 'cmd_bump'))
print("cmd_check:", hasattr(semver, 'cmd_check'))
print("cmd_compare:", hasattr(semver, 'cmd_compare'))
print("VersionInfo.isvalid:", hasattr(semver.VersionInfo, 'isvalid'))
